lines.text: 坂口医生，额头已经有汗了。先向外侧转一下脸。
lines.text_en: Dr. Sakaguchi, you're sweating on your forehead. Please turn your face away from the field for a moment.

lines.text: 嗯，麻烦你。手套现在可没法碰脸。
lines.text_en: Mm, thank you. I can't exactly touch my face with these gloves.

lines.text: 好了。术野这边我没有碰到，可以继续。
lines.text_en: All done. I haven't touched the sterile field. You can continue.

lines.text: 巡回，给我擦一下汗。刚才一直没空抬头。
lines.text_en: Circulator, could you wipe my forehead? I haven't had a moment to look up.

lines.text: 请稍微退开、把头转过来。……好了。
lines.text_en: Step back a little and turn toward me. ... All done.

lines.text: 坂口，额角那滴汗快掉下来了。先停一下，我看着这里。
lines.text_en: Sakaguchi, that drop by your temple is about to fall. Pause a second; I've got this area.

lines.text: 你倒是比我先发现。巡回，拜托。
lines.text_en: You spotted it before I did. Circulator, please.

lines.text: 头向右转一点。……擦好了。
lines.text_en: Turn a little to your right. ... There, all done.

lines.text: 我一直以为是灯太亮，现在看来是我真的在出汗。
lines.text_en: I thought the lights were just too bright. Apparently I'm actually sweating.

lines.text: 先别研究原因，脸转过来，我处理一下。
lines.text_en: Let's not investigate why. Turn your face this way and I'll take care of it.

lines.text: ……看来这件事还是得听你的。
lines.text_en: ...Looks like I should listen to you on this one.

lines.text: 这边牵开先请第二助手接一下，我要擦个汗。
lines.text_en: Second assistant, could you take over the retraction here? I need my forehead wiped.

lines.text: 接住了，术野位置不变。
lines.text_en: I've got it. The exposure won't change.

lines.text: 请转向外侧。……好了，辛苦。
lines.text_en: Turn away from the field, please. ... There. Thanks for your hard work.

lines.text: 第一助手，额头的汗快流到眉毛了，需要帮忙吗？
lines.text_en: First assistant, that sweat is about to reach your eyebrows. Need a hand?

lines.text: 需要，不过等我先把手里的吸引交给第二助手。
lines.text_en: Yes, but let me pass the suction to the second assistant first.

lines.text: 好。现在可以了，转过来一点。……擦好了。
lines.text_en: Of course. You're clear now—turn this way a little. ... All done.

lines.text: 下一段开始前，巡回，帮我擦一下额头。
lines.text_en: Before we start the next part, circulator, please wipe my forehead.

lines.text: 好的，先远离术野半步。……擦好了。
lines.text_en: Of course. Step half a pace away from the field first. ... All done.

lines.text: 第一助手，你先把脸上的汗处理一下。这一段我等你。
lines.text_en: First assistant, take a moment to get that sweat off your face. I'll wait.

lines.text: 好，我正想说。巡回，麻烦了。
lines.text_en: All right. I was just about to ask. Circulator, please.

lines.text: 不用急，先转过来。……好了。
lines.text_en: No rush. Turn this way first. ... Done.

lines.text: 第一助手，帮我接一下这支牵开器，我眼前有汗了。
lines.text_en: First assistant, please take this retractor for a moment. Sweat is getting in my eyes.

lines.text: 接好了，放心转过去。
lines.text_en: I've got it. Go ahead and turn away.

lines.text: 擦好了。你回来时先看清牵开器的位置。
lines.text_en: All done. Check the retractor's position before you resume.

lines.text: 你额头那滴汗已经挂了半天了，先处理一下。
lines.text_en: That drop's been hanging on your forehead for ages. Better deal with it.

lines.text: 我还以为能坚持到下一阶段。巡回，麻烦你。
lines.text_en: I thought I could make it to the next stage. Circulator, could you help?

lines.text: 往外侧转头。……好，回去吧。
lines.text_en: Turn away from the field. ... There, you can go back.

lines.text: 第二助手，需要擦汗吗？你可以等这段牵拉结束再过来。
lines.text_en: Second assistant, need your forehead wiped? We can wait until you've finished retracting.

lines.text: 正好结束了。谢谢，麻烦帮我一下。
lines.text_en: I've just finished, actually. Thanks—I'd appreciate it.

lines.text: 往外侧转一点。……好了。
lines.text_en: Turn outward a little. ... All done.

lines.text: 我没有累，就是额头这点汗有些碍事。
lines.text_en: I'm not tired. It's just that the sweat on my forehead is distracting.

lines.text: 我没有问你累不累。把脸转过来就行。
lines.text_en: I didn't ask if you were tired. Just turn your face this way.

lines.text: ……明白。谢谢。
lines.text_en: ...Understood. Thanks.

lines.text: 副器械，帮我盯一下无菌台。我需要擦汗。
lines.text_en: Second scrub, watch the sterile table for me. I need my forehead wiped.

lines.text: 台面和针数我接着，你可以转过去。
lines.text_en: I've got the table and the needle count. You can turn away.

lines.text: 这边。……擦好了，可以接回。
lines.text_en: Over here. ... Done. You can take over again.

lines.text: 下一组器械已经交接完，巡回，能帮我擦一下额头吗？
lines.text_en: The next instrument set is handed over. Circulator, could you wipe my forehead?

lines.text: 可以。先离开无菌台一点，头往我这边转。
lines.text_en: Certainly. Step away from the sterile table and turn toward me.

lines.text: 我继续盯着台面，不会漏下一件。
lines.text_en: I'll keep an eye on the table. We won't miss the next instrument.

lines.text: 第一器械，你帽沿下面开始出汗了。等这组针数核对完，我帮你擦。
lines.text_en: First scrub, you're starting to sweat under the edge of your cap. I'll help once you've finished this needle count.

lines.text: 好，这组已经核对完，可以了。
lines.text_en: All right, the count's complete. I'm ready.

lines.text: 先离开台面一点。……擦好了。
lines.text_en: Step away from the table a little. ... Done.

lines.text: 副器械先接台。巡回，我需要十秒钟。
lines.text_en: Second scrub, take the table. Circulator, I need ten seconds.

lines.text: 过来，脸向外。……好了。
lines.text_en: Over here. Face away from the field. ... All done.

lines.text: 谢谢。下一组缝线我来准备。
lines.text_en: Thank you. I'll prepare the next sutures.

lines.text: 这批备用器械已经排好，第一器械，台面先交还给你。
lines.text_en: The spare instruments are arranged. First scrub, the table's back in your hands.

lines.text: 收到，你去擦一下汗吧。
lines.text_en: Got it. Go get your forehead wiped.

lines.text: 头转过来一点。……好了。
lines.text_en: Turn your head this way a little. ... All done.

lines.text: 第二器械，你额头出汗了，我等你做完这组清点。
lines.text_en: Second scrub, you're sweating. I'll wait until you've finished that count.

lines.text: 还有最后两件……好了。第一器械帮我接台。
lines.text_en: Two items left... Done. First scrub, take the table for me.

lines.text: 请转向外侧，我帮你擦一下。……好了。
lines.text_en: Turn away from the field, please. Let me wipe that. ... All done.

lines.text: 我还以为戴着手术帽，就不容易出汗了。
lines.text_en: I thought wearing a surgical cap would keep me from sweating so much.

lines.text: 那是手术帽，不是吸汗毛巾。台面我接着。
lines.text_en: It's a surgical cap, not a sweat towel. I've got the table.

lines.text: 你先过来。……好了，下次别等到汗流下来。
lines.text_en: Come over here. ... Done. Next time don't wait until it's running down your face.

lines.text: 巡回，等我把备用线放好，帮我擦一下汗。
lines.text_en: Circulator, once I've set down the spare sutures, could you wipe my forehead?

lines.text: 可以。第一器械已经接手了，你往外转一点。……好了。
lines.text_en: Sure. The first scrub has taken over; turn outward a little. ... All done.
